column1: # Week 7 all-pairs table: one row per unordered pair of the Marvel supervillain pages.
# A = node_id that sorts first, B = the other. cos = cosine of MiniLM page vectors (rounded to 4 decimals, empty if a page has no vector).
# d_ab / d_ba = links on the shortest DIRECTED path A->B / B->A in the 370-page category graph; EMPTY when no such path exists (never a placeholder number).
# reach: both | a_to_b | b_to_a | none. same_wcc / same_scc: 1 if both nodes share a weakly / strongly connected component.
# a_in/a_out/b_in/b_out: in- and out-degree. Names, titles and URLs: see week7_characters.json.
